# Sam Vllaco

> Sam Vllaco (Samir Vllaco) is a product designer based in Tirana, Albania, with 10 years of experience designing SaaS, AI, fintech, health and e-commerce products for teams in the US, Europe, Canada, Australia and the UAE. He works alone, from the first call to handover, and can build the front end too.

## Hire Sam
- [Book a 30-minute call](https://samvllaco.com/book/): talk through your product and leave with a scope, a timeline and one next step.
- [Services](https://samvllaco.com/services/): SaaS product design, dashboards, AI product UX, mobile app design, UX audits, design systems, websites, landing pages, branding and SEO.
- [SaaS product design](https://samvllaco.com/services/saas-product-design/), [dashboard design](https://samvllaco.com/services/dashboard-design/), [AI product UX](https://samvllaco.com/services/ai-product-ux/), [mobile app design](https://samvllaco.com/services/mobile-app-design/), [UX audit](https://samvllaco.com/services/ux-audit/), [design systems](https://samvllaco.com/services/design-systems/), [prototyping and motion](https://samvllaco.com/services/prototyping-motion/), [website design](https://samvllaco.com/services/website-design/), [landing pages](https://samvllaco.com/services/landing-pages/).
- [AI-built app design fix](https://samvllaco.com/services/ai-app-design-fix/): for founders who built an app with Cursor, Lovable or v0 and want a designer to fix how it looks.
- [Branding](https://samvllaco.com/services/brand/), [development](https://samvllaco.com/services/build/), [marketing design](https://samvllaco.com/services/marketing-design/) and [SEO](https://samvllaco.com/services/seo/).

## Products
